title: PRISM perspective registry
description: Machine-readable shape of registry.yaml, published so that an operator vendoring a lens set through PRISM_REGISTRY_PATH can validate it with ordinary tooling before PRISM ever sees it. This schema is documentation, not the enforcement point: prism.preflight.registry.PerspectiveRegistry.load is authoritative and applies rules JSON Schema cannot express, including symmetric mutual exclusion, resolvable exclusion targets, adversarial/constructive balance, rejection of YAML anchors and tabs, and the critical-lens satisfiability rule. tests/unit/preflight/test_registry_schema.py fails if the two drift apart.

version.description: Semantic version of the registry content. Any semantic change to a lens requires a bump; the report carries it so a routing decision is always traceable.

id.description: Stable identifier. Appears in every preflight report, so renaming one is a breaking change.

purpose.description: What this lens is responsible for, in one line, addressed to the host model.

questions.description: The required questions the lens must answer. Bounded so that one lens cannot consume the host's whole analysis budget.

mutually_exclusive_with.description: Lenses that must never be selected alongside this one. Must be symmetric and must resolve to declared ids; the loader enforces both.

claim_budget.description: Maximum claims the host may return for this lens. Bounded by MAX_CLAIMS_PER_CANDIDATE.

risk_tags.description: Closed vocabulary. Every lens is exactly one of adversarial or constructive; critical marks a lens as mandatory or near-mandatory for high-consequence work.
